name: convert_code
description: Convert one code format to another (e.g. from hexadecimal to decimal, or from binary to decimal). Use this tool when you need to transform a specific code representation into another format. Do NOT use this tool for general-purpose encoding/decoding tasks (e.g. base64 encoding) — use 'encode_decode_code' for that.

parameters.name: input_code
parameters.description: The code to be converted, represented as a string. Must be in the format appropriate for the specified conversion (e.g. hexadecimal should only contain characters 0-9 and A-F). Length must be between 1 and 20 characters.

parameters.name: from_format
parameters.description: The format of the input code. Must be one of: 'hexadecimal', 'binary', 'decimal'. This specifies the current representation of the input_code.

parameters.name: to_format
parameters.description: The desired output format for the conversion. Must be one of: 'hexadecimal', 'binary', 'decimal'. This specifies the target representation of the output code.

converted_code.description: The converted code in the target format (to_format).

return_schema.description: Object containing the converted code in the specified output format.
